name: Mobius Transform
desc: A conformal Mobius transformation endlessly warps a colored checker grid on the complex plane, bending straight lines into circles as elliptic and loxodromic flows swirl the whole field toward and away from two drifting fixed points.

density.doc: grid detail / cell count (higher = finer tiling)

twist.doc: spiral winding of the grid (loxodromic shear)

sep.doc: separation between the two fixed points
